implementation: feat(w1.8): add game moderation telemetry and operations
environment: Windows/Docker Desktop Linux/Node22; Nest11/TypeORM0.3/PostgreSQL16/Redis7/Mailpit/Nginx; postgresql16-client pg_dump/pg_restore; guarded disposable databases

checks.playablePackage: passed typecheck, build, dependency graph/network allowlist, budget and zip; no backend/analytics imports
checks.backendLint: passed without warnings in builder container

coverage: Swagger documents /api/v1/admin/city-bloxx/runs*, /api/v1/city-bloxx/catalog, /api/v1/city-bloxx/analytics/events and /guest-events; RBAC permissions city_bloxx_moderation:read/update enforced and no arbitrary score edit route exists

quarantine hides run from public/private boards, automatically restores owner's next-best remaining run, extends raw input retention to 90 days, and release re-runs deterministic worker resimulation before restoring board standing
server emits verification_reject telemetry on invalid run settlement; client cannot forge verification_reject; rejected or input-expired runs fail release with 409 conflict

public catalog returns cacheable versioned classes/cosmetics/rulesets; authenticated and guest analytics enforce 13-event allowlist, UUID idempotency dedupe, origin check, recursive PII/secret key rejection, unverifiedTelemetry labeling, and 30/min Redis rate limits with Retry-After and 503 fail-closed on Redis outage

distributed-locked idempotent retention sweep purges 30-day visible run inputs while protecting <90-day quarantined inputs, preserves computed receipts/metrics/boards, and purges 90d+ quarantined inputs across CLI maintain retries

daily pg_dump backup with 14-day retention pruning and separate-DB pg_restore rehearsal preserve all 15 auth+game tables, verify cloud save SHA-256 hashes, and boot compiled Nest app (/health/ready, /leaderboards/quick, /catalog)

security.status: passed; all 51 existing routes + 7 W1.8 routes documented in Swagger

checks.gateway: passed actual production Web routing, auth/cookie/origin/redaction/parser limits
checks.runtimeArtifacts: passed compiled Quick/Daily core and save workers

artifacts.note: Runner reports and temporary backup dumps are local disposable artifacts; this tracked summary records successful results.

limits: Moderation release requires retained raw inputs (<=90 days while quarantined); once purged by retention sweep, release returns 409 GAME_MODERATION_INPUTS_EXPIRED rather than trusting unverified stored scores.
Client and guest analytics events are always tagged unverifiedTelemetry=true; only server verification settlement can emit source=server verification_reject events.

Backup and restore rehearsal verified against disposable PostgreSQL 16 databases in Docker local/staging; production TLS/SMTP/cron scheduling and full W1 end-to-end acceptance remain W1.9 and deployment gates.
